core_objective: Choose the next diagnostic that distinguishes competing explanations under fixed scope and budget

advance_policy.runtime_integrity: all boundary tests pass; no sealed or real data access
advance_policy.integration: all planned host cases terminate validly within budget with traceable evidence
advance_policy.diagnostic_review: unsupported conclusions and false findings are explicit failures to review, not hidden by average score
advance_policy.adaptive_superiority: NOT_ESTABLISHED_BY_SMALL_SMOKE; requires separate frozen larger evaluation including planner costs and family-level uncertainty
advance_policy.real_pilot: only after integration and failure review; bounded exploratory pilot is not production rollout
advance_policy.promotion: existing factor and strategy contracts remain required; synthetic success never promotes a factor

paper_basis.adopted: adaptive falsification design and separation of designer/executor
paper_basis.not_assumed: conditional e-value validity on reused financial panels
